name: linuxsec
description: Linuxsec — Advanced Native VPN Client for Linux (WireGuard & OpenVPN)

scripts.build: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist:deb: npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb --publish never
scripts.dist:rpm: npm run build && electron-builder --linux rpm --publish never
scripts.dist:appimage: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux deb AppImage rpm --publish never
